answer: Agents start at the nadir of trust: joining costs real money, not an email. Each registration posts a bond on a public ledge, unlocked only after 90 days of dispute-free attestations, so cloning identities means cloning capital. Vouching is rationed: an agent may sponsor two newcomers per quarter, and sponsors forfeit 30% of their bond if a protege is caught in a collusion ring. Every handshake carries a cipher-based proof bound to a distinct hardware key and funding source, so peers can spot fifty independent agents descending from one wallet.
